# Chrome Extension: YouTube Vocal Isolator

This Chrome extension removes background music from YouTube videos while preserving vocals using Web Audio API.

## Project Type
Chrome Extension using JavaScript and Web Audio API

## Key Features
- Vocal isolation from YouTube videos
- Real-time audio processing
- Toggle on/off functionality
- Integration with YouTube player
